mechanisms.subject: TCS
mechanisms.economic_channel: The reported AI run rate can motivate segment research. It is not automatically new revenue on top of consolidated revenue. Compare deal conversion, pricing and delivery cost before forecasting per-share cash flow.
mechanisms.countercase: AI-linked offerings can replace existing work. Margin figures use different exceptional-item bases, so automated margin comparisons are blocked.
mechanisms.invalidation: Subsequent comparable disclosures fail to show incremental growth or sustainable margins.
mechanisms.expectations: Independent consensus and current valuation are NOT_COLLECTED. No quantified surprise or buy call.

mechanisms.subject: INFY
mechanisms.economic_channel: Deal TCV is a multi-period contract measure, not current-quarter sales. Test conversion into comparable revenue and cash flow before estimating earnings.
mechanisms.countercase: The issuer lowered the FY27 guidance ceiling despite AI progress. More AI activity does not establish stronger aggregate demand.
mechanisms.invalidation: Comparable revenue or cash generation fails to improve as contracts convert.
mechanisms.expectations: Management guidance is not independent analyst consensus. Current valuation and consensus are not collected.

mechanisms.subject: HCLTECH
mechanisms.event: AI delivery growth versus capital intensity
mechanisms.economic_channel: Track whether AI and new contracts raise per-share cash flow after proposed data-centre investment. Separate revenue from bookings and planned capital spending.
mechanisms.countercase: AI expansion can require substantial capital before utilisation is proven. Bookings do not identify the timing or margin of recognised revenue.
mechanisms.invalidation: Cash conversion, capacity utilisation or contract execution falls short of the stated plans.
mechanisms.expectations: Current valuation, consensus and detailed capex funding are missing. No stock-return forecast.

mechanisms.subject: LT
mechanisms.event: Capital recycling through a conditional disposal
mechanisms.economic_channel: A disposal can free capital for engineering and technology businesses, but consideration is not earnings or cash received. Track approval, closing, debt transfer, tax and the use of proceeds.
mechanisms.countercase: Closing conditions remain. The prior financial-year report is not proof of the disposal status on the current market date.
mechanisms.invalidation: Closing fails or net released capital falls short after transaction and financing obligations.
mechanisms.expectations: Current disposal status, consensus, enterprise valuation and stock-price reaction are not collected.
